en.title: Neale's Mysterious Mona Lisa
en.content: Neale was so curious about the famous Mona Lisa painting that he decided to make his own version! He wondered why the lady in the painting has such a mysterious smile. Maybe she just heard a really funny joke? Or maybe she has a secret pet dragon hiding behind her chair! In Neale's version, he gave Mona Lisa rainbow-colored hair and a big ice cream cone to make her smile even bigger. Neale thinks if Leonardo da Vinci saw his painting, he would laugh and say, That's much more colorful than mine!

zh.title: 恩恩的神秘蒙娜丽莎
zh.content: 恩恩对著名的蒙娜丽莎画像非常好奇，所以他决定创作自己的版本！他想知道画中的女士为什么有这么神秘的微笑。也许她刚刚听到了一个非常有趣的笑话？或者她有一条秘密的宠物龙藏在她的椅子后面！在恩恩的版本中，他给蒙娜丽莎彩虹色的头发和一个大冰淇淋筒，让她的笑容更大。恩恩认为，如果达芬奇看到他的画，他会笑着说：这比我的更加多彩！
